name: Coins
description: The realm's currency. Even the dying world still runs on coin.

name: Bones
description: Something used to live in these.

name: Skull
description: It's looking at you. Don't make it weird.

name: Copper Ore
description: Unassuming. Unbothered. Already in a union.

name: Tin Ore
description: Copper's quiet neighbour.

name: Iron Ore
description: Heavier than its problems.

name: Coal
description: Compressed time and pressure, much like you.

name: Mithril Ore
description: Glows faintly. Refuses to explain why.

name: Logs
description: They were a tree. They're handling the change poorly.

name: Oak Logs
description: Denser. Grumpier. Still logs.

name: Willow Logs
description: Weep for them, or with them.

name: Raw Shrimp
description: Furious about being caught. Too small to do anything about it.

name: Raw Trout
description: Put up a fight. Lost.

name: Raw Lobster
description: Technically still defending itself.

name: Cooked Shrimp
description: Heals 3 HP. Still furious, but compliant.

name: Gritty Shrimps
description: Cooked over a tin-ore fire, which turned out to be exactly as advisable as it sounds. Deals 10 damage.

name: Cooked Trout
description: Heals 10 HP.

name: Cooked Lobster
description: Heals 25 HP. The lobster has given up.

name: Bronze Bar
description: Copper + tin, melted together in their shared grief.

name: Iron Bar
description: Forged. Dense. Dependable.

name: Chaos Rune
description: Vibrates anxiously even when nothing is happening.

name: Death Rune
description: Extremely calm about everything. Suspicious.

name: Magic Staff
description: Still charged with something. Doesn't say what.

name: Iron Sword
description: Reliable. Won't start conversations.

name: Troll Hide
description: Tough. Smells of bridge and regret.

name: Gold Ore
description: Shiny. The trolls hoard it but never explain why.

name: Dragon Bones
description: Worth an incredible amount. Also weigh an incredible amount.

name: Dragon Scales
description: Iridescent. The dragon didn't want to give them up.

name: Faint Residue
description: A trace of something that used to matter. You can feel it resisting.
